permission_origin.decision: Preparation only. Root must obtain specific user direction for this read-only target-window PrintWindow technology before execution; missing tool inventory is not authorization.
guidance_quotes: Do not automate terminal applications such as Windows Terminal, Command Prompt, or Windows PowerShell.
Use only the Computer Use JS APIs for Windows app automation.
permission_origin.cua_runtime_rule_as_reported_by_root: Do not use other technologies besides cua_repl...unless specifically requested

constraints: Exact allowlisted DevBrain UX or Capture title and expected HWND/PID/process start timestamp.
Official installed Windows Terminal package executable and same session; canonical paths without reparse output.
Retained process identity plus HWND/title/thread/class/executable/geometry checks immediately before and after PrintWindow.
Memory DC and bitmap only; no screen-copy fallback, activation, input, resize, elevation or persistent settings changes.
Own hidden child is bounded20seconds plus5seconds actual-exit wait; only this retained child can be terminated.
CreateNew local PNG and JSON in existing private qualification root; no overwrites/uploads.
Blank/unrendered client or API/identity/path failure is BLOCKED; nonblank image awaits visual review and never grants UX PASS.
limitations: PowerShell ParseFile checked only; embedded C# deliberately not compiled and APIs not executed before permission.
PrintWindow may not render GPU-composed Windows Terminal content; a blank result remains BLOCKED.
Windows recycles HWNDs and provides no immutable cross-process window lifetime handle. Before/after binding reduces the race but does not make window lifetime atomic.
A temporary DPI-awareness context affects only the worker thread and is restored; no system display setting changes.
PNG reflects the named window, not proof of terminal cell geometry or product correctness; operator must inspect it.
